visual_argument: One plant at one scale, counted in its own units: the part it already makes, the machines it already added and expects to add, and beside them Hadrian's 24 as empty taped bays, the one block of the story that has not cut a part and the only one the AI language belongs to.
build_risk: Frame 6 is 124 units in plan on a dark floor under a low key: 100 machine roofs that must each read as a machine (column, tool drum hood, pendant, stack pole and its long cast) rather than graph paper, and 24 accent tape outlines that must read as empty bays at 432 px. Built with TXBENCH.relief from the machining_centre's own plan dimensions, aisles along the cast.
distinct_from_recent: No. 55 (Oct 20) was floodlit operating room interiors under a cold high key with a wall of sterile containers and dusk gold. No. 54 (Oct 18) was lastLight brush country exteriors with a windmill and bluebonnet. No. 53 (Oct 17) was tissue section reliefs with dusk ember. This deck is a machine shop under a low west key through dock doors, machined aluminium and graphite enamel, plan reliefs of a floor at one scale, and a cold comal lit accent that marks only the cell.
